references.text: The prophecy that the dead will rise and come out of their graves, parallel to Lazarus coming out of the tomb bound.
The prophecy that God will abolish death forever, a theme Jesus confirms by raising Lazarus from the dead.
Jesus explains that those in the graves will hear his voice and come out, a direct prerequisite for Lazarus' resurrection.
Description of Lazarus' burial clothes and face cloth, which also appear in Jesus' own resurrection, where the face cloth is rolled up separately.
